calendarFaqs.q: When is the first day of school for Austin ISD in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school on Austin ISD's revised traditional calendar is Tuesday, August 18, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Austin ISD in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school on Austin ISD's revised traditional calendar is Thursday, May 27, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Austin ISD fall break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Austin ISD's fall break runs Monday, November 23 through Friday, November 27, 2026, covering the full Thanksgiving week. Students return Monday, November 30.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Austin ISD winter break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter break runs Monday, December 21, 2026, through Monday, January 4, 2027. Students return Tuesday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Austin ISD spring break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Austin ISD spring break runs Monday, March 15 through Friday, March 19, 2027. The break overlaps SXSW 2027, which runs March 15–21.

calendarFaqs.q: What is a PLED day in Austin ISD?
calendarFaqs.a: PLED stands for Professional Learning Exchange Day. Austin ISD explains that eligible employees can complete professional learning outside regular work time in exchange for designated PLED days.

calendarFaqs.q: Does every Austin ISD campus follow this calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. This page covers the revised traditional calendar. Austin ISD's ADSY page lists six proposed half-days for participating campuses on selected dates, so families should confirm their campus calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: Which Austin ISD dates are bad-weather makeup days?
calendarFaqs.a: October 9, 2026, and March 26, 2027, are listed as student holidays and bad-weather makeup days. Check Austin ISD updates after any weather-related closure.

customSections.label: Traditional Calendar and ADSY Campuses
customSections.content: This page covers Austin ISD's revised traditional calendar. Participating ADSY campuses use a different schedule on selected dates.

groups.label: Traditional calendar
items: The revised traditional calendar lists 171 instructional days.
The six proposed ADSY half-days fall on dates when students following the traditional calendar do not attend school.
April 30 is a separate student holiday/PLED day on the traditional calendar.

groups.label: ADSY campuses
items: Austin ISD's ADSY page lists six proposed half-days for participating campuses: September 21, October 9, November 2–3, March 10, and March 26.
Families at ADSY campuses should use the campus calendar before making childcare or travel plans.

customSections.label: What Austin ISD Parents Should Know
customSections.content: The revised calendar has a few details that are easy to miss when planning childcare, travel, or return-to-school dates.

groups.label: PLED days
items: September 21 and April 30 are student holidays/PLED days. PLED stands for Professional Learning Exchange Day.

groups.label: Bad-weather makeup dates
items: October 9 and March 26 are currently student holidays, but Austin ISD also designates them as bad-weather makeup days.

groups.label: Break names
items: The official calendar calls November 23–27 Fall Break, even though it covers Thanksgiving week.
Winter break runs December 21 through January 4, and students return Tuesday, January 5.

groups.label: Spring break and SXSW
items: Austin ISD spring break overlaps SXSW 2027, which runs March 15–21. Because the dates overlap, central Austin is likely to be busier than usual during spring break.

customSections.label: What Changed from 2025–26
customSections.content: Compared with 2025–26, the revised traditional calendar starts and ends one day earlier.

rows: First day moved from August 19 to August 18
The school year starts one day earlier than the 2025–26 traditional calendar.
Last day moved from May 28 to May 27
The student year ends one day earlier than the 2025–26 traditional calendar.
